profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II
profile.summary:
The rootinest tootinest web dev in the West. Coffee-swiggin', cat-cuddlin', throttle-twistin' son-of-a-gun with a penchant for adventure.

Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable B2B SaaS platforms and data-intensive applications for entertainment, education, and public sectors. Proven track record developing high-performance web applications serving major film/TV studios and gaming companies, with expertise in modern React architectures, real-time data processing, and 3D visualization technologies. Combines strong technical foundation in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and cloud infrastructure with creative background in animation and motion graphics, enabling unique problem-solving approaches for complex user experiences. Demonstrated ability to lead full-stack development from concept to deployment, optimize performance at scale, and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders to deliver business-critical solutions.



Languages - JavaScript • TypeScript • Python • Go • Rust

Frontend - React • React Native • Expo • JQuery • TailwindCSS  • shadcn/ui • Zustand • Tanstack Query • React Router • Babylon.js • Three.js • Zxcvbn-ts

Backend - Node • Next.js • Express.js • Koa • Django • Drizzle • Prisma • Zod

Tools - AWS • Docker • Git • MongoDB • PostgreSQL • SQLite • Redis • Socket.io • Mocha • Jest • Jira • Figma • GitHub Actions • Bitbucket Pipelines

Email: null@timeforzeros.com
Website: https://timeforzeros.com
GitHub: https://github.com/timeforzeros

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Full Stack / React Front End Engineer
positions.description:
Lead front end/full-stack developer for React and React Native SaaS platform using TypeScript, Expo, Tanstack Query, TailwindCSS, Shadcn, Express, Node, MongoDB, Django. Engineered complete AWS cloud video processing pipe.

Designed and built custom 3D annotation tool for AI research using React, Nextjs, Node, Python, BabylonJS,
ThreeJS, Zustand and PostgreSQL. Featured intuitive multi-modal interface with real-time
synchronization. Delivered comprehensive analytics dashboard with productivity telemetry and interactive querying capabilities.

Migrated legacy systems from jQuery and EJS to unified React/React Native codebase enabling
cross-platform web/mobile development. Built comprehensive CI/CD pipelines with automated testing,
linting, containerized deployment, and Docker Registry management.

positions.title: Animator
positions.description:
Produced high-quality motion graphics and compositing work in After Effects for Cornell University's eCornell online learning platform, enhancing educational content delivery for thousands of students across diverse academic programs.

Designed and developed custom vector-based puppets and interactive props in Adobe Illustrator for CommonSense mobile application, creating engaging visual assets that improved user interaction and app functionality.

Executed comprehensive character rigging, visual design, and animation workflows using Adobe Animate CC and Photoshop, delivering polished animations that brought digital content to life through advanced keyframing techniques.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Animation · Motion Graphics · Adobe Creative Suite · JavaScript · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Supervisor of Curriculum and Staff Development
positions.description:
LEARN is a nonprofit organization helping underserved students at 24 school sites in El Monte, Whittier and Pomona.
Manage and coach 24 Site Coordinators and their teams for quality and grant adherence
Plan and approve curricula and educational materials for K-12 students served at 24 school
sites that satisfy federal learning outcomes
Facilitate and develop trainings for coordinators and frontline staff
Meet with school and district personnel to better serve their respective students’ needs
Create the schoolyear’s training, curricula and assessment schedules

positions.title: Mathematics/ ACT Instructor
positions.description:
Conceptualized and planned the year-long curriculum for the Math Intervention program
Collected and analyzed student academic data to find trends in student progress and need
Increased student ACT Math performance by an average of 4 points via Math Intervention

educations.fieldOfStudy: Biological and Physical Sciences and Mathematics

projects.description:
The game 2048 built using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React and Node) using JavaScript. I initially built this by first assessing the rules, designing the layout, working on the move logic and lose logic. I then re-built it using the React library and connecting it to a database to add leaderboard functionality. Currently working on mobile friendly version.


Play the game at: 

https://timefor2048.herokuapp.com

projects.title: Long Beach Transit Website and Trip Planner
projects.description:
Long Beach Transit's website allows users to access Long Beach Transit's services and resources as well as upcoming events. Their biggest feature is the trip planner that maps out bus routes and bus stops which include fare price and bus arrival time.

I consulted on this project to resolve and update front and back end issues.
